tagline: Context-aware sticky notes on any business document with pins, mentions, and reminders
problem: Critical customer context is buried in chatter, spreadsheets, or personal notebooks instead of the document users are working on.
solution: Attach colorful sticky notes to sale orders, invoices, CRM leads, contacts, products, and employees. Pin warnings, mention teammates, use templates, and schedule reminders without opening the chatter.
benefits: Keep payment warnings and VIP flags visible on the record
Mention teammates without leaving the form
Fast OWL panel without opening chatter

features.title: Document panel
features.text: Add, pin, edit, and delete notes from a clean panel on sale orders, invoices, CRM leads, and more.

features.title: Pinned cards
features.text: Pin VIP, payment delay, and delivery warnings so they always appear first.

features.title: Mentions
features.text: Notify teammates when they are mentioned on a note.

features.title: Templates
features.text: Admins define VIP, payment delay, delivery call, and credit risk quick notes.

features.title: Reminders
features.text: Set a reminder date and Smart Notes creates an Odoo activity automatically.

features.title: Visibility
features.text: Control who sees each note: Everyone, Only Me, Sales Team, or Managers.

workflow: Open a sale order or invoice
Add a note from the panel
Pin or use a quick template
Mention a teammate or set a reminder
seo_keywords: Odoo 20, Odoo Community, Smart Notes, sticky notes, context notes, sale order notes, invoice notes, CRM notes, rn_smart_notes, ARMORA IT Technologies

faq.q: Which documents are supported in V1?
faq.a: Sale orders, purchase orders, invoices, CRM leads, contacts, products, and employees.
Yes. Set visibility to Only Me, Sales Team, Managers, or Everyone.
Yes. A reminder date on a note creates a linked Odoo activity on the source document.

faq.q: Does it work on Odoo 20 Community?
faq.a: Yes. Built for Odoo 20 Community with OWL 2 backend assets.
